methodology.scale: 0–100; higher values indicate less favourable conditions / higher risk
methodology.world_risk_formula: W = geometric mean(E, V) = sqrt(E × V)
methodology.aggregation: geometric means across the official hierarchy unless the metadata formula states otherwise
methodology.normalization: official normalized 0–100 values in the trend file; GIR does not renormalize
methodology.missing_data: official imputation methodology; GIR does not add imputation and does not replace nulls with zero
